hasIcon.description: Whether to display a secondary icon (e.g., system/source) in the item. When true, the icon slot is rendered.

shelved.description: Indicates if the alert is shelved (temporarily deferred). When true, a tertiary icon is shown to represent the shelved state.

day.description: The day label for the alert (e.g., "Yesterday").

time.description: The time label for the alert (e.g., "14:30").

status.description: The current status of the alert item. Determines visual style, icon, and action button visibility. Possible values: 'unacknowledged', 'caution', 'acknowledged', 'no-ack-alarm', 'no-ack-warning', 'rectified'. Default...

open.description: Whether the item is expanded/open to show additional details. Toggled by clicking the item.

size.description: Layout size of the menu item. Controls whether content is single-line or multi-line. Possible values: 'single-line', 'multi-line'. Default is 'single-line'.

animateIntro.description: Whether to animate the item's appearance (intro animation).

secondaryActionLabel.description: The label for the secondary action button. Unlike the primary (ACK) action, the secondary label is not derived from status; it must be provided explicitly. The secondary action is only shown when a non-empty label is...

primaryActionState.description: Controls the appearance of the primary (ACK) action. See ObcAlertMenuItemActionState for the available states.

secondaryActionState.description: Controls the appearance of the secondary action. See ObcAlertMenuItemActionState for the available states.

iconName.description: The icon in the `icon` slot, by name (an OpenBridge icon the module bundles); empty puts none. Optional secondary icon (e.g., source/system).

alertIcon.description: The alert icon at the start of the row, one `obc-alert-icon`, as a list with one object for each: `tag` and then the element's attributes by name, `text`, `id` (reported by the element's events), `slot` and `children` (objects of the same form). Tags and attributes: `obc-alert-icon` (alertType, type, acknowledged, active, silenced, flashingSpeed).

componentSize.description: OpenBridge component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
